blurb: Guests fish for salmon, trout, steelhead, and lake trout guided by Captain Andy Odettee on fully equipped boats. The season begins in early spring and runs through September, with the best big salmon fishing mid August through September. Trips accommodate beginners and families, focusing on a friendly atmosphere and lasting memories.
extraNote: No Fish No Charge policy · Maximum 6 passengers per trip · Deckhand gratuity not included · North Star Marina (next door to the Cabbage Shed) 212 Frankfort Ave, Frankfort (Elberta), MI. 49628 · Early spring through September
